instruction: Open C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_032_draft_wall_part.step in SolidWorks. Using SolidWorks command-line automation, use that input file, an 80 x 50 x 35 mm open-top box with vertical outer side walls, 3 mm wall thickness, and 3 mm bottom thickness. Apply a 2 degree outward draft to all four outer side walls using the bottom face as the neutral plane. Keep the bottom outside size 80 x 50 mm fixed at Z=0 and do not move the bottom. The top outside size should increase consistently with 35 mm height and 2 degree draft to about 82.44 x 52.44 mm. Export C:\Users\User\Desktop\cli_032_drafted_part_out.step. [Software] Launch SOLIDWORKS from `C:\Program Files\SOLIDWORKS Corp\SOLIDWORKS\` (use your actual executable or shortcut).
